name: Mending Touch
description: Lay a warm palm on a cut or bruise so healing qi closes the skin and eases an ally or the self.

name: Warm Palm
description: Rest a warm hand on a strained muscle and feed it steady qi until an ally or the self loses the ache.

name: Evened Breath
description: Guide a tired ally's breathing into a slow even rhythm so qi circulation settles and strength returns.

name: Delicate Probe
description: Run a thread of qi lightly over a patient to feel where an injury lies and how deep it goes.

name: Cupped Veil
description: Cup a thin veil of qi over an open wound so grit and further blows cannot reach the hurt ally.

name: Knitting Thread
description: Draw a fine thread of qi along a torn muscle to pull its edges together while an ally or the self mends.

name: Simple Salve
description: Spread a film of healing qi over a scrape or shallow cut so the wound of an ally or the self dries.

name: Closing Press
description: Press the edges of a bleeding wound together with both thumbs while qi seals them and the flow of an ally slows.

name: Easing Stroke
description: Draw the flat of the hand along a sore limb so qi flushes the stiffness and pain from an ally or the self.

name: Ache Lull
description: Hold two fingers to the seat of a deep ache and pour in cooling qi until an ally or the self can rest.

name: Radial Reading
description: Rest three fingers on the wrist of a patient and read the beat of the pulse for fever or weakness.

name: Calm Anchor
description: Rest a hand on a frightened ally's shoulder and send slow qi down the arm so panic loosens its grip.

name: Soft Step
description: Glide to a fallen ally in two light paces with qi damping every footfall so the hurt body is not jarred.

name: Glowing Hand
description: Let healing qi gather in the palm as a soft glow and lay it over an ally's wound until it fades into the skin.

name: Embered Warmth
description: Warm the hands with gentle qi and fold them round a chilled limb so the blood of an ally or the self runs again.

name: Fever Draw Palm
description: Press a cool palm to a burning brow and draw the heat out along the arm so the fever of an ally breaks.

name: Bellows Sense
description: Listen with qi to the rise and fall of a patient's chest to learn whether the lungs are clear or clogged.

name: Tender Guard
description: Spread a soft skin of qi over a bandaged limb so a knock does not reopen the hurt of an ally.

name: Calm Rhythm
description: Tap a slow beat on an ally's back and match it with qi so a racing heart falls into an even pace.

name: Slow Breath
description: Breathe in time with a winded ally and let qi carry the rhythm across so the lungs of the ally widen and steady.

name: Rhythm Mend
description: Guide a stuttering pulse back to an even beat with small pulses of qi at the wrist of an ally or the self.

name: Lung Ease
description: Press qi through the chest wall to loosen a tight breath and clear the lungs of an ally or the self.

name: Pulse Hold
description: Hold a flickering pulse steady with a fine grip of qi so the heart of a failing ally keeps its beat.

name: Weary Lift
description: Pass a warm surge of qi through clasped hands to lift the dragging limbs of an exhausted ally.

name: Clean Wrap
description: Wind a band of woven qi round a clean wound so it stays closed while an ally or the self knits.

name: Poultice Press
description: Press a cushion of dense healing qi onto a deep bruise so the pooled blood of an ally or the self disperses.

name: Bruise Fade
description: Rub a circle of qi into a purpled bruise until the colour and tenderness of an ally or the self fade.

name: Swelling Ease
description: Draw the fluid out of a swollen joint with slow strokes of qi so an ally or the self can bend it again.

name: Dust Ward
description: Raise a fine screen of qi over an open dressing so dust and spray cannot foul the wound of an ally.

name: Warm Compress
description: Hold a pad of gently heated qi against a stiff back or neck until the cramp of an ally or the self lets go.

name: Tender Sense
description: Brush qi across a dressing to feel whether the wound beneath is clean or turning foul.

name: Quiet Pulse
description: Still the healer's own breath and read the faint pulse of a patient who lies too weak to speak.

name: Pulse Mend
description: Smooth a ragged pulse with fine ripples of qi at the wrist until the heartbeat of an ally or the self evens out.

name: Unhurried Salve
description: Smooth a thin layer of qi over a scald and let it sink in so the skin of an ally or the self cools.

name: Rested Hands
description: Shake out the healer's own hands and steady them with a pulse of qi so a fine task is done without a tremor.

name: Gentle Lift
description: Lift the sagging weight of a fatigue headache off an ally or the self with two fingers and a pulse of qi.

name: Calm Flow
description: Slow the flow of a small bleed by easing the vessel with a cool thread of qi until an ally or the self clots.

name: Bleed Stanch
description: Clamp the torn vessel shut with a knot of qi so the bleeding of an ally or the self stops at once.

name: Bone Setting Hold
description: Align a cracked bone by feel and clasp it in a sleeve of qi so an ally or the self can bear the pain.

name: Sprain Ease
description: Wrap a sprained ankle or wrist in warm qi that draws out the swelling and loosens the torn fibres of an ally.

name: Joint Soothe
description: Roll a stiff joint slowly while qi oils it so the grinding of an ally or the self fades.

name: Thaw Touch
description: Rub warmth into numb fingers and toes so feeling returns to an ally or the self after the cold.

name: Wound Sense
description: Pass qi over a bleeding body to find which wound is deepest and so which one to tend first.

name: Healer's Ward
description: Throw a pane of firm qi over the patient and the healer alike so a stray blow does not undo the work.

name: Eager Step
description: Spring to a wounded ally's side in one bound with qi cushioning the landing so the healer arrives balanced.

name: Small Kindness
description: Breathe a little healing qi into a scratch or blister so it closes for an ally or the self without scar.

name: Light Mend
description: Pass a fingertip of qi over a split lip or small gash and watch the flesh of an ally or the self draw shut.

name: Hearty Draw
description: Draw on the healer's own reserve and press a measure of vigour into a flagging ally through a gripped hand.

name: Soft Cradle
description: Hold a cushion of qi round a sleeping or fainting ally so jolts do not reach the hurt body.

name: Pain Hush
description: Dull the sharp edge of a fresh pain with cooling qi so an ally or the self can think and breathe.

name: Gentle Gauge
description: Measure with a touch how much strength a patient has left so the healer spends only what is needed.

name: Soothing Hand
description: Stroke a distressed ally's brow and neck with calming qi until the throb of the hurt subsides.

name: Cooling Touch
description: Lay a hand of cool qi on a burn to pull the heat from the skin of an ally or the self.

name: Tension Unwind
description: Work along a knotted shoulder with slow qi until the cramped muscles of an ally or the self let go.

name: Tender Glow
description: Wake a soft glow beneath the palm and keep it over a healing wound so tissue regrows faster in an ally.

name: Rest Draw
description: Draw a worn ally into a short deep rest with soft qi at the temples so strength gathers again.

name: Patient Mend
description: Feed an old wound a trickle of healing qi through many slow breaths until an ally or the self is whole.

name: Slow Renewal
description: Coax tired skin and muscle to regrow in thin layers with patient qi so an ally or the self recovers by degrees.

name: Still Hands
description: Still the healer's own tremor with a pulse of qi so a delicate repair can be carried through.

name: Mild Tonic
description: Send a mild nourishing stream of qi into a recovering ally so appetite and colour return.

name: Vital Gauge
description: Test with a light touch how well a recovering patient holds qi so the next treatment is set right.

name: Mild Screen
description: Keep a mild screen of qi round a bed-ridden ally so drafts and knocks never trouble the recovery.
